assignees: ''
---

> **Clinical concerns are triaged first.** For time-sensitive issues currently affecting patients, please ALSO email [support@infusionfox.com](mailto:support@infusionfox.com) directly so it doesn't wait on GitHub notifications.

## What page or calculator

URL or calculator name. Be specific (e.g., `/fentanyl`, `/cpr/compute`, "RECOVER 2024 defib table on /cpr").

## What the calculator currently shows

Copy the specific text, dose range, or interpretation. Include species selection, weight, and any other inputs that produced the output.

## What it should show (per source)

What you believe the correct value or guidance is.

## Source

The published reference that supports your correction. At least one of:

- Textbook chapter and edition (e.g., "Silverstein & Hopper 4th ed Ch. 88")
- Peer-reviewed paper (DOI or PubMed ID preferred)
- Current Plumb's monograph
- Veterinary consensus statement (RECOVER, ACVECC, IRIS, etc.)
- Formulary (specify which one and which edition)

If the disagreement is between two sources, list both and explain which one you think should take precedence and why.

## Patient context (optional, if relevant)

Species, body weight range, comorbidity, or clinical scenario where the current value is problematic. Helps the maintainer understand whether the issue is universal or context-specific.

## Severity

How time-sensitive is this?

- [ ] Acute safety concern: current value could cause patient harm if used today
- [ ] Outdated guidance: the dose range is from a superseded reference
- [ ] Citation drift: the value is supportable but the cited source doesn't match exactly
- [ ] Cosmetic: formatting, units, or display issue

## Additional context

Any other information you think is relevant. Screenshots welcome but not required.
